avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces ponatinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue at least 2 weeks before ponatinib initiation; use alternative antidepressant

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract/Seed
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases ponatinib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; switch to orange juice or other citrus without furanocoumarins

avoid_supplements.name: High-Dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate antiplatelet/anticoagulant effects increasing bleeding risk with ponatinib-induced thrombocytopenia
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU daily; monitor CBC and bleeding signs

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase ponatinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for toxicity signs; dose adjustment may be needed if combined

caution_supplements.name: Garlic Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce ponatinib exposure
caution_supplements.action: Use modestly; assess efficacy if high doses initiated

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance antiplatelet effects; additive bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bleeding parameters; generally acceptable at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Pomelo
avoid_foods.mechanism: Furanocoumarins irreversibly inhibit CYP3A4, significantly increasing ponatinib bioavailability and toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit, pomelo, and tangelo; safe alternatives include oranges and lemons

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase ponatinib absorption; absorption is variable but generally food-independent
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain uniform dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Indole-3-carbinol may induce CYP1A2 and modestly affect metabolism
caution_foods.action: Maintain normal dietary intake; excessive supplementation should be avoided

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of ponatinib toxicity (arterial thrombosis, pancreatitis, hepatotoxicity) especially when CYP3A4 inhibitors are co-administered. Assess CBC regularly due to thrombocytopenia risk, particularly if antiplatelet supplements or NSAIDs are used concurrently.
